features.title: Material compatibility grouping
features.migration_boundary: Generic grouping and an advisory FOrca planner exist; neither proves Snapmaker material-grouping parity.

features.title: Interface pre-extrusion distance and length
features.migration_boundary: Compare actual four-tool paths and interface extrusion using stock U1 macros.

features.title: Interface temperature and tool-change thermal waits
features.migration_boundary: A matching temperature key does not prove matching waits, standby or reheating behavior.

features.title: Cooling before tower and during interfaces
features.migration_boundary: Validate cooling commands and ordering in generated U1 G-code; no heater/fan hardware tests.

features.title: Tower ribs, wall gap, brim and chamfer
features.migration_boundary: Some options are shared; fork-only geometry keys need coupled geometry tests, not inert schema entries.

features.title: Special U1 tool-change and docking paths
features.migration_boundary: Retained machine macros are not proof of optimized Snapmaker tower/tool-change path equivalence.

features.title: Non-Bambu Type 1 tower material accounting
features.migration_boundary: Verified only for the adopted upstream engine regression and full FFF suite, not physical U1 material usage.

features.title: Transition layers, speed, flow and perimeters
features.migration_boundary: Snapmaker transition schema/consumer path is absent; import its coupled generator and tests.

features.title: Minimum support-interface contact-area threshold
features.migration_boundary: Do not substitute ordinary interface spacing or generic support style for this threshold.

features.title: Snapmaker adaptive tree support layers
features.migration_boundary: Ordinary adaptive model layers do not establish this support-specific algorithm.

features.title: Top and bottom painting penetration controls
features.migration_boundary: Compare segmented geometry and boundaries; source presence is not U1 painting parity.

features.title: Automatic negative raft/support expansion
features.migration_boundary: Released Snapmaker v2.4.1 and audited main accept -1; selected official engine minimum is zero. Preserve path-specific semantics, never silently clamp.

features.title: Ratio mixing
features.migration_boundary: Official and Snapmaker mixed-filament metadata differ; compare recipes and resulting extrusion.

features.title: Cycle and interleaved-layer mixing
features.migration_boundary: Do not label ordinary multi-material painting as cycle mixing.

features.title: Color Match and matching algorithms
features.migration_boundary: Identify algorithm/color-space and recipe constraints, then compare known target colors.

features.title: Gradient curves and ranges
features.migration_boundary: Similar controls use different serialization; verify curve/range round trips and generated layers.

features.title: Color decomposition and component selection
features.migration_boundary: Native decomposition implementation retained; U1 material/recipe/color reproduction remains unverified.

features.title: Geometry subdivision and textured segmentation
features.migration_boundary: Retained subdivision must be checked for mesh validity, paint fidelity and slicing effects.

features.title: Advanced dithering, pointillism and local-Z modes
features.migration_boundary: Multiple Snapmaker-specific keys are absent; do not equate generic mixed layers with the advanced modes.

features.title: Color Patch shell/core geometry and loops
features.migration_boundary: Distinct FOrca feature; ordinary painting and Full Spectrum are not equivalents.

features.title: Independent mixed nozzle configuration and mapping
features.migration_boundary: Generic mixed 0.4/0.6 paths were tested; complete FOrca mapping and imported projects are not verified.

features.title: Per-nozzle wall, infill, support and tower widths
features.migration_boundary: Generic percentage widths are not the complete FOrca per-nozzle arrays and precedence.

features.title: Per-nozzle feature speeds and thermal constraints
features.migration_boundary: Port definitions and every consumer together with migration and safety tests.

features.title: Outer/inner wall and sparse/solid infill tool assignments
features.migration_boundary: Native role assignments exist. FOrca names, array semantics and imported project equivalence need adapters.

features.title: Support/interface/prime-tower filament selection
features.migration_boundary: Retained generic selectors require FOrca/U1-specific generated path validation.

features.title: Per-object and per-filament overrides
features.migration_boundary: Generic overrides remain; fork-specific schema and precedence are not losslessly migrated.

features.title: Nozzle verification and incompatibility checks
features.migration_boundary: Do not substitute planner success for nozzle/material safety.

features.title: Advisory filament/nozzle partition planner
features.migration_boundary: Verified native planner/protocol tests; advisory only and does not check physical material compatibility.

features.title: U1 LAN discovery and network submission
features.migration_boundary: Generic Moonraker/Snapmaker agent source is retained, but full stock/gateway parity is not verified.

features.title: Snapmaker gateway transport and device protocol
features.migration_boundary: Current gateway adapter and its companion/service packaging are missing; audit dependencies and licensing before import.

features.title: Snapmaker cloud account, pairing and authorization
features.migration_boundary: Orca cloud or Bambu login is not Snapmaker pairing. Credentials/services required for live verification.

features.title: Device status, job, progress and temperatures
features.migration_boundary: Source paths exist; use recorded stock/Extended fixtures before live read-only confirmation.

features.title: U1 camera, authentication and streaming
features.migration_boundary: Generic printer-video infrastructure exists, but no validated U1-specific camera transport/authentication integration is present. GUI/Camera.cpp is the 3D viewport camera and is not evidence of printer streaming. Snapmaker routes camera start/timelapse through SSWCP and its MoonRaker host/Flutter device bridge; these are not present as an equivalent U1 integration.

features.title: U1 RFID/NFC filament metadata and refresh
features.migration_boundary: Current NFC metadata reader is bounded evidence only; generic Bambu RFID controls are not U1 parity. No UID fabrication/writing.

features.title: Filament inventory, assignments and synchronization
features.migration_boundary: Local assignment exists; current Snapmaker inventory/mapping synchronization remains incomplete.

features.title: Automatic feeding and unloading
features.migration_boundary: Need exact stock feeder API/state machine and offline fixtures. Do not execute hardware commands during this work.

features.title: MultiACE device integration
features.migration_boundary: Firmware-/device-dependent FOrca integration is not imported or hardware-verified.

features.title: Top cover/door/enclosure capability and status
features.migration_boundary: Exact stock sensor/API and third-party cover variant must be identified. A printer cover thumbnail or chamber setting is not sensor integration.

features.title: High-flow hotend detection and compatibility
features.migration_boundary: Snapmaker flow-variant schema, SSWCP payload and profile selection are coupled and not fully ported.

features.title: Uniform 0.2 mm U1 profile
features.migration_boundary: Preset is present; no claim of physical calibration or supported material combinations.

features.title: Uniform 0.4 mm U1 profile
features.migration_boundary: A retained-profile cube sliced/exported in Linux; physical printing and every process/material remain unverified.

features.title: Uniform 0.6 mm U1 profile
features.migration_boundary: Preset is present; complete material/process and physical validation is missing.

features.title: Uniform 0.8 mm U1 profile
features.migration_boundary: Preset is present; complete material/process and physical validation is missing.

features.title: Mixed 0.4+0.6 U1 profile and arbitrary head combinations
features.migration_boundary: 0.4/0.6 synthetic engine paths verified. One visible preset is not a FOrca-only hardware limit.

features.title: Printer wizard and selected-preset visibility
features.migration_boundary: All five diameter variants exist in the system catalog; inspect selection visibility without changing existing user configurations.

features.title: U1 machine start/end/tool-change macro preservation
features.migration_boundary: Do not replace stock docking/feeding/temperature macros with generic commands; generated outputs require semantic comparison.

features.title: Attribution, inheritance, collisions and user overrides
features.migration_boundary: Immutable review catalogs are tested; unvalidated/calibration and separate-profile redistribution gates remain.

features.title: Original Snapmaker 3MF import and configuration migration
features.migration_boundary: Original Snapmaker reference imports fail on -1. Unknown/renamed settings and array semantics need explicit migration.

features.title: 3MF save/export and metadata fidelity
features.migration_boundary: Own-project export passed. Vendor round-trip preservation and fork-specific metadata are not proven.

features.title: FOrca schema and object/filament metadata migration
features.migration_boundary: A known set of FOrca keys has no native equivalent/schema consumer. Never drop them silently.

features.title: Native protocol, authentication and stdio
features.migration_boundary: Native component/transport and real GUI HTTP/stdio smoke passed; this is not full client or printer verification.

features.title: Move, rotate, scale, arrange and inspect
features.migration_boundary: Typed handlers are retained; allowed subset and actual runtime tests differ by operation.

features.title: Slicing, estimates, consumption, warnings and export
features.migration_boundary: Native STL/cube slicing passed; project/file export handlers remain gated pending review.

features.title: Open/import/create/save/export projects and files
features.migration_boundary: Upstream handlers exist but U1 policy denies them. Authorized roots do not by themselves authorize destructive overwrite.

features.title: Object/material/support/profile authoring
features.migration_boundary: Most configuration mutation is intentionally gated until argument/credential/approval review.

features.title: Duplicate/delete and destructive operation approval
features.migration_boundary: Source is not equivalent to exposed tools; destructive operations need operator-bound confirmation.

features.title: Authorized printer state, submission and controls
features.migration_boundary: No reviewed operator-bound printer-control adapter. Generic UI/script/plugin bridges remain blocked.

features.title: Stock U1 firmware API and G-code behavior
features.migration_boundary: Must compare actual stock API fixtures, command vocabulary and tool mapping; hardware remains untested.

features.title: Extended Firmware 2.1 and optional services
features.migration_boundary: Do not infer all installations expose identical Moonraker, camera, NFC or macro services.

features.title: Dynamic capability detection and explicit unknowns
features.migration_boundary: Need unified per-service/version capability negotiation and recorded fixtures, not hardcoded version assumptions.

features.title: Bundled plugin discovery, consent and installation
features.migration_boundary: Native installation/load and disabled staging tests pass; Windows GUI catalog verification belongs to the next candidate build.

features.title: Studio read-only project inspection and preflight
features.migration_boundary: Actual pinned core inspection and no-mutation checks passed. Conversion/clamping/printer controls are not exposed.

features.title: External converter connector and project-copy workflow
features.migration_boundary: Actual loopback service round trip passed and preserved input hash. Noncommercial implementation is not distributed.

features.title: Windows-trusted Authenticode signatures
features.migration_boundary: Signing/verification pipeline prepared; no signing identity is configured. Self-signing is not Windows-trusted signing.

features.title: Native macOS ARM64 application and packaging
features.migration_boundary: Component checks are not a full macOS application build; stable release gate remains.

features.title: Physical single/four-tool/mixed-nozzle validation
features.migration_boundary: No physical U1 prints are authorized or performed. 100% physical compatibility cannot be certified offline.

features.title: Retained walls, infill, cooling, seams and G-code engine
features.migration_boundary: Full FFF suite passed for its scope; it does not prove every retained feature with every U1 profile.

features.title: STL/STEP/3MF, modeling, painting and CAD
features.migration_boundary: Native implementations retained. Complete U1 workflows and full source-to-reference comparison are not executed.

features.title: Calibration and process workflows
features.migration_boundary: Audit printer-specific calibration commands before claiming U1 safety; no hardware tests run.

features.title: Integration changes, disabled features and default policies
features.migration_boundary: Whole-source diff against MCP base is recorded. MCP restrictions and isolated identity are intentional changes, not full exposed upstream parity.

features.title: Detect and reconcile reported U1 high-flow hotends
features.migration_boundary: A generic nozzle-volume setting does not detect installed U1 high-flow hardware. Port reported per-head flow state and conflict checks using documented firmware/gateway fixtures.

features.title: Snapmaker development cooling, infill margin and short-travel changes
features.migration_boundary: Six additional schema names at Snapmaker b070bcf, beyond exact v2.4.1, are absent here. Inspect consumers and possible renamed equivalents before deciding whether to port cooling transitions/slowdown, external infill margin and short-travel acceleration. Add source-attributed behavior and G-code comparisons; no inert settings or automatic profile substitution.
